name: Nuoc mam chat
summary: Traditional fish sauce made from the local catch at Giao Hải, tasted on the Xuân Thủy coastal day. It is a different sauce from nước mắm Sa Châu.
origin: Giao Hải, on the coastal day inside the Xuân Thủy visit. Vườn quốc gia Xuân Thủy.
where: Giao Hải. It is not the Sa Châu gift sauce.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam chat — Giao Hai fish sauce
seoDescription: Fish sauce from the local catch at Giao Hải, tasted on the Xuân Thủy coastal day.
